text: On it — checking the week's schedule before I write to Professor Alvarez.

Update: the department office says the faculty senate meeting this Wednesday 10:00-11:00 is still on — nothing this week has been cancelled, and hallway talk isn't confirmation. So I'm not booking 10:00 Wednesday; I've asked Professor Alvarez for another free time this week and for the official schedule so I know my own free hours.

Settled, and not the way the morning note planned it.

The 10:00 Wednesday slot was never available: the office confirmed in writing that the faculty senate meeting (Wed 10:00-11:00) is on and that nothing this week was cancelled — hallway talk doesn't count. I couldn't take it, and Professor Alvarez agrees it stays untouched.

So the meeting is booked for **Wednesday 18 November, 12:30-13:00** — his proposal, free on both sides (his grant writing ends 12:30, his department meeting starts 14:00; my free window is 10:00-15:30), nothing official touched, and he's confirmed it in a one-liner. Both calendars have it.

I've asked the office to keep it in their record, and I've offered him Tue/Thu/Fri as fallbacks if something shifts.
